about: generated by tools/test_domains.py --write: each test's domains (the domains of the files it depends on) and the test scripts it runs or imports. check.py runs a test when a changed file is in one of its domains or is one of its scripts.

domains.test-scripts: the tests themselves: a change selects the tests that run or import the file
domains.plugin-native: the game plugins' C++ and what the C++ tests compile
domains.native-codec: native/: the installer's C++ codecs (edf6cmpl) pylib loads by ctypes
domains.installer: the install chain: installer, release, weapon tables, ownership ledger, test hub client
domains.edf41: EDF4.1 ports: objects, maps, sounds, outfits
domains.cockpit: first-person cockpits: their parts, fits, kits and the cut interiors
domains.testrange: the test range launcher and its catalog
domains.pylib-model: model and asset generation: pylib's formats and model builders, the make_* generators
domains.tools-misc: the other tools (viewers, reverse-engineering helpers, perf tooling)
